public_health_question.v: How were U.S. deaths involving watercraft injuries distributed by month during 2018–2020?

ev.q: Percentage Distribution of Deaths Involving Injuries from Recreational and Nonrecreational Use of Watercraft,* by Month — United States, 2018–2020
During 2018–2020, 1,508 deaths occurred involving injuries from recreational and nonrecreational use of watercraft.
Deaths resulted from drowning, submersion, and other types of injuries. All water transport deaths were unintentional.
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data.
